//: Ceilings for the single-file shells. Raise one IN THE COMMIT that needs the bytes, and say what bought them. Checked by scripts/test-spaces-size.mjs.

spaces.//: 132 KiB. The tracker took spaces from 73 KB. Headroom is deliberate: the shell is mostly a zlib block and zlib differs across node versions — the same commit measured 130,095 B on node 26 locally and 131,246 B on CI node 24, so a tight ceiling fails in CI for no reason. CI is the number that counts.
